verdict.rationale: Foreloop's skills mechanism covers this story's purpose. The docs tell you to write a skill when you find yourself giving an agent the same correction twice, and each task contract carries the relevant skills into the run, so agents start with your team's expectations. `foreloop init` also installs skill content into the checkout. Missing for 10: documentation of how a convention skill is authored (file format, location, or whether it lives in the repo), evidence that skills shape the agent-proposed plans/tasks and not only code execution, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
